summary: Barclays PLC filed a Form 6-K with the SEC (equivalent to a current report under US rules) to disclose routine share transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities (PDMRs). Two PDMRs, Cathal Deasy and Taalib Shaah, disposed of shares via the Barclays nominee service on May 22 and May 26, 2026, respectively. Deasy sold 1,014,557 shares at £4.436 per share; Shaah sold 300,000 shares at £4.566 per share. No board recommendation, advisor, or special corporate action is noted. This is a routine regulatory reporting of insider share dealings, not a transformative event.
